heading: 13.6 Round modes
text:
### 13.6 Round modes [LUNI.13.6]

The six canonical mode string values:

| Mode | Behavior | Typical use |
|---|---|---|
| `"half_even"` | Round half to nearest even ("banker's") | ISO 80000-1; high-volume accounting (no bias) |
| `"half_up"` | Round half away from zero | EU VAT line items; consumer display |
| `"half_down"` | Round half toward zero | Some IRR / loss-attribution paths |
| `"ceiling"` | Always toward +∞ | Conservative billing |
| `"floor"` | Always toward −∞ | Bank interest accrual (don't over-credit) |
| `"truncate"` | Toward zero | Audit / forensic — discard fractional |

Any other string value at the mode position: `DS_VALIDATE_CURRENCY_UNKNOWN_ROUND_MODE`.
Non-string expression at the mode position (variable reference, computed
value, etc.): `DS_VALIDATE_CURRENCY_ROUND_ARG_NOT_STRING`. The mode must
be a string **literal** so the validator can check it at compile time;
runtime-computed mode strings are not admitted (a runtime-typo'd mode is
a footgun the type system can prevent).
